title: Sitting Pillows
body:
This mod adds a Sitting Pillow to the game, which can be placed anywhere and sat on. The pillow is not a block, instead it's an entity similar to how Item Frames work. After crafting it from 4 String and 1 Feather, it can be dyed like Leather Armor. Right-clicking will place it on the center of the block but if crouching it will instead place it exactly where you are pointing. This can also allow you to place it inside blocks (e.x. into Stairs). Once placed, it can be interacted with to sit on and retrieved with a right-click while crouching. Mobs that touch it will also sit on it.
<center>
